entities.summary: Jeffrey Scott Skinner is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward who is currently a free agent. He most recently played for the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected seventh overall by the Carolina Hurricanes in the 2010 NHL entry draft, and has also played for the Buffalo Sabres and Edmonton Oilers.
